name: Hydra acceptance length and speedup on Vicuna-13B (temperature=0)
methodology: temperature=0, 6 tasks. Average acceptance length τ = 3.40 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 2.69x mean across tasks.
notes: Hydra++ with sequentially-dependent draft heads. Improves over Medusa by up to 1.31x. Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding.
